study_tips: Break your study sessions into 25-minute Pomodoro intervals with 5-minute breaks.
Teach what you've learned to someone else — it reinforces memory strongly.
Use active recall: close your notes and try to remember key points from memory.
Review your notes within 24 hours of a lecture to boost long-term retention.
Stay hydrated and take short breaks every hour to keep your brain fresh.
Use mind maps to visually connect and organize concepts.
Set specific, measurable goals for each study session.
Avoid multitasking — focus on one subject at a time for deeper understanding.
Practice past exam questions to understand the pattern and test your knowledge.
Sleep at least 7-8 hours — sleep consolidates memory and improves focus.
